resources.string:
1. Category: usage statistics (rest, focus, distance, and ambient-light trends). What is collected: usage trend data such as rest sessions, focus duration, viewing distance, and ambient light. Purpose: to generate usage reports and provide suggestions for improvement. Storage and retention: stored only in the database of the app on your device; deleted when the app is uninstalled or app data is cleared. Sharing: not shared; nothing is uploaded to any third party.
2. Category: camera frames. What is collected: frames captured by the camera, used only for distance and blink/dry-eye analysis. Purpose: to analyze viewing distance and blink/dry-eye state entirely on your device. Storage and retention: processed locally in real time only; not saved, recorded, or uploaded. Sharing: not shared; the frames never leave your device.
3. Category: ambient light and screen brightness. What is collected: ambient-light sensor readings and screen brightness settings. Purpose: to adjust screen brightness and eye-protection effects automatically based on the environment. Storage and retention: read and used locally only; not uploaded or stored in the cloud. Sharing: not shared.
4. Category: diagnostics and crash information. What is collected: crash logs, diagnostic information, face-analysis samples, and the installed-app inventory (when you enable the related features). Purpose: to locate issues and improve the quality and stability of the app. Storage and retention: off by default; only uploaded to our backend when you enable it, for analysis and improvement. Sharing: uploaded to our servers only when enabled; not disclosed to unrelated third parties.
5. Category: device installation identifier (installation ID / device fingerprint). What is collected: an installation identifier and a device fingerprint generated on first run. Purpose: to identify the device and to verify request signatures. Storage and retention: stored in the encrypted store on the device, used locally for verification and request signing only. Sharing: not shared; not used for advertising or profiling.
6. Category: app inventory (Shizuku network control). What is collected: the list of installed apps, read only when you use the Shizuku network-control feature. Purpose: to provide per-app network access control. Storage and retention: off by default; used locally only when the related feature is enabled. Sharing: not uploaded unless you explicitly enable it.
7. Category: account information (email, etc.). What is collected: account information such as your email address, provided when you sign in. Purpose: to provide cloud backup and sync. Storage and retention: stored by our backend only after you sign in; you can sign out or request deletion at any time. Sharing: processed by our backend only for cloud backup and sync.
8. Category: backup files. What is collected: the backup file you choose to export or import. Purpose: to provide local or cloud backup and restore. Storage and retention: kept where you choose, either locally or in the cloud (cloud storage requires sign-in). Sharing: local backups are not shared; cloud backups are processed by our backend only when you are signed in.
